column5: The named first function in rc4.o initializes the permutation table and is called directly by do_rc4 before the output allocation.
The SDK object places htoa at offset 0x130. The gethex loop calls it once for each of two input characters.
The SDK object places gethex at offset 0x1cc. The decode branch of do_rc4 calls it after allocating the input bytes.
The SDK object places tohex at offset 0x29c. The encode branch of do_rc4 calls it before freeing the intermediate buffer.
